title: AiAnalysisResponse
description: Response payload returned by the internal AI service. Phase 7 only. The response is grounded in retrieved context; references identify which context items supported each part of the answer.

status.description: Outcome status. 'Ok' when grounded answer produced; 'InsufficientContext' when retrieval did not produce enough material; 'ValidationFailed' when the validator rejected the model output; 'Error' for any other failure.

response.description: The generated answer (post-validation, still masked - the UI applies unmasking if and only if the requesting user is authorized).

references.description: Context items the model was given. Used by the UI to render citations.

modelName.description: Identifier of the self-hosted model used. E.g., 'llama3.1:8b-instruct'.

auditId.description: Identifier of the audit.AiAuditLog row created for this interaction. Every response is audited.

warnings.description: Non-fatal issues the validator surfaced (e.g., 'response was truncated', 'context coverage low').
